_: K: a rule the code enforces when it runs; found when an R line of rules.md names one of its lines. D: looks like a rule but isn't enforced; claimed when an R line names one of its lines, or describes it (its words) without saying it isn't enforced.

K1.what: only a treating doctor may refer the patient; anyone else gets NotFound

K2.what: a second referral to a clinic with one still open returns the open one

K3.what: a reason is required and at most 500 characters (the API answers 400)

K4.what: only an open referral can be accepted; otherwise 409

K5.what: a clinic's queue shows only open referrals from the last 90 days, oldest first

K6.what: a patient gets at most MaxPerPatientPerDay (3) referrals per UTC day; more answers 429

D1.what: patients over 65 skip the queue: only a comment says so

D2.what: a 10% discount from the 5th visit: FeeCalculator is never called

D3.what: a daily cap of 5: MaxDailyReferrals is never used

D4.what: a referral expires after 30 days: only the README says so

D5.what: a note is required and a reason at least 10 characters: the validator is never registered
